name: Luminos Client
description: The first-party Luminos in-game companion: quick panel (Right Ctrl), custom title screen, liquid-glass quick panel with search, favourites and per-module settings, icon-based HUD, render-loop click sampling, fullbright, shulker tooltip, snapping HUD editor and profiles. Pairs with Sodium, Lithium and Entity Culling in the Luminos Client bundle.
